content.text: Recent commits all show the correct author, but your history does have three different identity variants (`Filip Culig <filip.culig@gmail.com>`, `Filip Čulig <...@users.noreply.github.com>`, `Filip Čulig <filip.culig@gmail.com>`), and nothing looks ahead of `origin/master` locally. To fix this properly I need a bit more detail.

questions.question: Which commit(s) have the wrong author, and where are they?

options.label: Just the latest commit, not pushed yet
options.description: Easiest case — amend the commit locally with `git commit --amend --author`, no history rewrite needed elsewhere.

options.label: Latest commit, already pushed
options.description: Amend locally, then force-push that one branch (needs your confirmation since it rewrites shared history).

options.label: One or more older commits, buried in history
options.description: Needs an interactive rebase to rewrite specific commits' author info, then a force-push if already pushed.

options.label: Not sure / other repo
options.description: Tell me more about it, or point me at the repo/branch if it's not this one.
